method.order: all (track, engine, snapshot, trial) tasks shuffled together with a fixed seed, then run with bounded concurrency
method.sameInputs: every engine receives the identical citizen state and the identical eligible-action set
method.jev: POST api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, model jev-1.13.0, one Choice question over the eligible actions (same task as the LLMs)
method.llm: OpenRouter chat completions, strict JSON Schema (Track A: action enum only; Track B: action enum + probability per action), temperature 0.2, require_parameters, no provider fallbacks
method.rules: deterministic hand-written heuristic with a fixed seed per snapshot (the city itself uses seeded jitter for variety)
method.scope: Choice-only requests measured on fixed city snapshots, not full four-question JEV City transactions. Results depend on model, provider routing and benchmark environment.
caveats: LLM probabilities are model-reported estimates, not calibrated probabilities; JEV probabilities are native model output.
Schema-valid is not the same as correct. Decision quality is not evaluated by this benchmark.
Rules latency is an in-process function call and is not comparable to network round-trips.
Both engines get the same state JSON and the same action descriptions; the LLM additionally receives a natural-language instruction wrapper.
Latency depends on network, region and provider load at the time of the run.

A.description: Action selection: LLMs return only the chosen action (strict enum). JEV answers one Choice question.

latencyMs.boundary: HTTPS round-trip from the benchmark host
